record.one_liner: Meta's Marketing API for creating, managing and reporting on ads across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp.
record.auth_notes: OAuth dialog with scope=ads_management or ads_read is documented. critic: added api_key because the authorization page documents system users (Business Manager system-user access tokens, static, non-OAuth) with per-tier capacity; the token type itself is not quoted on the fetched page, so medium confidence.
record.access_notes: Limited access is granted automatically when the Marketing API product is added to an app. Full access (rate limits, Business Manager access, 10 system users) requires App Review. critic: confirmed approval_required.
record.api_notes: Covers campaigns, ad sets, ad creatives and ads, plus insights. Graph API based (HTTP style inferred as rest).
record.blocker_notes: Limited access works for development, but production use needs Full access via App Review. critic: confirmed.
